verdict.rationale: The evidence describes user-side controls: spending rules, merchant-locked order intents, and scoped, revocable agent permissions. It also mentions URL whitelisting for client-side API keys and a wallet policy engine. None of these is a merchant-facing way to rate-limit, allow, or deny specific agents or agent platforms accessing a catalog or checkout. These are adjacent controls, so they earn no credit.

support.subject: As a merchant, I can rate-limit, allow, or deny specific agents and agent platforms accessing my catalog and checkout
